f63c8887d0c98dc5.description: About the Role We are looking for a hands-on and results-driven Influencer Marketing Senior Specialist to cover DinoAI's influencer marketing initiatives in Saudi Arabia. You will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and managing local creators, developing culturally relevant influencer campaigns, and driving measurable brand awareness, user acquisition, and business growth. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of the Saudi creator ecosystem, proven experience managing end-to-end influencer partnerships, and the ability to combine creative storytelling with data-driven performance optimization. Key Responsibilities 1. Influencer Strategy & Creator Development Develop and execute influencer marketing strategies tailored to the Saudi market, aligned with DinoAI's brand positioning and growth objectives. Identify, evaluate, and recruit relevant influencers and content creators across Snapchat, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and other local platforms. Build and maintain a high-quality creator pipeline, including macro, mid-tier, micro-influencers, and KOCs. Assess creator authenticity, audience demographics, engagement quality, brand fit, and commercial potential. 2. Partnership Management & Negotiation Independently manage influencer outreach, relationship building, commercial negotiations, and partnership agreements. Negotiate competitive collaboration fees, deliverables, content usage rights, whitelisting, and repurposing permissions. Build sustainable relationships with local creators, agencies, and relevant community partners. Manage creator onboarding, briefing, content timelines, publishing schedules, and campaign deliverables. 3. Campaign Execution & Localized Content Plan and execute influencer campaigns covering product awareness, app trials, user acquisition, and conversion. Collaborate with creators to develop authentic, engaging, Arabic-first content that resonates with Saudi audiences. Ensure all influencer content aligns with DinoAI's brand guidelines, local cultural expectations, and relevant advertising requirements. Coordinate with internal content, creative, paid media, and growth teams to amplify high-performing creator content. 4. Performance Tracking & Optimization Monitor influencer campaign performance using metrics such as reach, engagement, CPM, CPC, CPA, installs, conversion rates, and ROI/ROAS where measurable. Evaluate creator performance and optimize budget allocation, content formats, and partnership strategies. Establish structured campaign reporting, creator performance tracking, and post-campaign reviews. Identify opportunities to turn high-performing organic creator content into paid advertising assets. 5. AI-Enabled Influencer Operations Leverage AI tools to improve influencer discovery, audience research, competitor analysis, content ideation, and campaign reporting. Use AI-assisted workflows to analyze creator content, audience sentiment, engagement patterns, and campaign performance. Apply AI tools to improve operational efficiency while ensuring human verification of creator authenticity, cultural suitability, commercial terms, and content quality. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field. 3+ years of hands-on experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or social media marketing, preferably within Saudi Arabia. Strong knowledge of the Saudi influencer ecosystem, particularly Snapchat, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube. Proven track record of independently managing influencer campaigns, from creator sourcing and negotiation to execution and performance evaluation. Established local influencer relationships and the ability to identify high-potential creators. Strong commercial negotiation, project management, and stakeholder communication skills. Native-level Arabic proficiency and working proficiency in English. Strong understanding of Saudi consumer behavior, cultural nuances, and digital media trends. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with a hands-on execution mindset. Must be based in Saudi Arabia. Preferred Qualifications Experience in B2C mobile apps, EdTech, AI products, subscription services, or consumer technology. Experience working with family, parenting, education, or lifestyle creators. Proven experience using influencer-generated content in paid advertising campaigns. Familiarity with app acquisition funnels, attribution, and performance marketing metrics. Practical experience using AI tools to improve marketing productivity and decision-making.

f622235339fbb18d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سالي للتسويق عن أمين صندوق للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإدارة المالية، بما في ذلك إدارة التدفقات النقدية والسيولة والتمويل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الأرصدة النقدية اليومية وتحليل التدفق النقدي من العمليات والاستثمار والتمويل. ضمان كفاية التدفقات النقدية وتوقع المدفوعات النقدية والتنبؤ بالمشكلات المحتملة. تحليل متطلبات رأس المال للعمليات التجارية والمعاملات والالتزامات الأخرى. تقديم الدعم في وضع سياسات وإجراءات الرقابة الداخلية المتعلقة بإدارة الموازنة والنقد والائتمان والمحاسبة. تحليل وإدارة المخاطر المرتبطة بالتدفقات النقدية، وإجراء تحليل الحساسية لتقييم تقلبات التدفقات النقدية. تحليل وتحديد خيارات شروط التمويل لتلبية الاحتياجات التشغيلية والاستثمارية. السعي للحصول على مصادر التمويل والتفاوض حول شروط التمويل. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال إدارة الخزانة أو التخطيط المالي. فهم قوي لمبادئ إدارة التدفقات النقدية والسيولة والتمويل. القدرة على إجراء تحليلات مالية دقيقة، بما في ذلك تحليل السيولة ومخاطر سعر الفائدة والعملة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات المالية المعقدة. مهارات تفاوض ممتازة وقدرة على بناء علاقات مع المؤسسات المالية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. إتقان استخدام الأدوات والبرامج المالية ذات الصلة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في تبوك. سيعمل أمين الصندوق ضمن فريق مالي لدعم الأهداف التشغيلية والاستثمارية للشركة. التقديم للمهتمين بالتقديم على هذا الدور، يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لتحديد الخطوات التالية في عملية التوظيف.

f6bdb6569eb110fb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ابناء معتوق حبيب البلادي مقاولات عن مهندس جيوتقني للانضمام إلى فريقها في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة خصائص مكونات الأرض وتصميم الأساسات المناسبة لمشاريع الإنشاءات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في المجال الجيوتقني. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تركيب وخصائص مكونات الأرض وإجراء الأبحاث اللازمة في هذا المجال. تصميم أعمال الحفر والأساسات للمشاريع الإنشائية، مع تحديد المواد ومعايير الجودة المطلوبة. تقديم الدعم الفني للمشاريع الهندسية والإشراف على عمليات بناء الأساسات. إعداد الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة المتعلقة بالمشاريع الجيوتقنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الجيوتقنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالمشاريع الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات كمهندس جيوتقني. فهم عميق لتركيب وخصائص مكونات الأرض. القدرة على تصميم الأساسات وأعمال الحفر للمشاريع الإنشائية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في التحليل والتصميم الهندسي. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. مهارات تواصل فعالة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة في جميع مراحل المشروع. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الجيوتقني ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة ابناء معتوق حبيب البلادي مقاولات في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع حسب متطلبات المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. نشجع المهندسين الجيوتقنيين ذوي الخبرة المطلوبة على التقديم.

f6252bc99f5a3730.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking a Hull Outfitting Engineer (Construction Support – CS) to join our team. This full-time role requires 5–10 years of experience in marine and shipbuilding projects. The successful candidate will provide essential technical and engineering support to shipyard production teams, focusing on hull outfitting activities. Key Responsibilities Provide construction and production support for hull outfitting activities in marine and shipbuilding projects. Review, update, and revise hull outfitting engineering deliverables, including arrangement and installation drawings, deck and external hull outfitting layouts, access platforms, walkways, ladders, stairway arrangements, handrails, guardrails, gratings, safety barriers, hatches, manholes, doors, access opening arrangements, foundations, supports, attachment details, fabrication, installation, and assembly drawings, 2D drawings, and 3D hull outfitting models. Review engineering drawings, shop drawings, and production information to identify discrepancies and resolve design-related issues. Provide technical support to shipyard production teams during hull outfitting fabrication, installation, and assembly activities. Resolve technical queries (TQs), drawing discrepancies, installation issues, and hull outfitting-related production problems. Incorporate engineering changes, production feedback, and redline mark-ups into drawings and 3D models. Coordinate with Hull Structure, Naval Architecture, Machinery Outfitting, Piping, HVAC, Electrical, and other engineering disciplines to ensure proper design integration and avoid clashes. Review vendor drawings, equipment interfaces, and technical documentation for compatibility with hull outfitting arrangements. Verify outfitting attachments, foundations, supports, access arrangements, and installation clearances against approved engineering requirements. Ensure hull outfitting drawings comply with project specifications, applicable classification society rules, marine standards, safety requirements, and shipyard construction procedures. Participate in constructability reviews to identify potential design conflicts, installation constraints, and fabrication challenges before execution. Review production feedback and recommend suitable design modifications to facilitate fabrication, installation, and assembly activities. Coordinate with engineering teams, production personnel, and other disciplines to ensure timely resolution of technical and installation-related issues. Maintain updated engineering drawings, technical records, and documentation in accordance with project procedures. Support as-built drawing updates and incorporate final installation and production modifications, where required. Ensure construction support engineering deliverables are completed within agreed project schedules and quality requirements. Qualifications and Experience Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or an equivalent engineering discipline. 5–10 years of relevant experience in hull outfitting engineering within marine, shipbuilding, shipyard, or offshore vessel projects. Hands-on experience in Construction Support (CS), shipyard technical support, and engineering drawing modifications. Strong experience in hull outfitting arrangements, deck outfitting, access platforms, ladders, handrails, gratings, hatches, and associated installation details. Proficiency in marine 3D design software, preferably AVEVA Marine / Hull & Outfitting, or other client-accepted shipbuilding CAD software. Experience reviewing and modifying 2D engineering drawings, 3D models, fabrication drawings, and hull outfitting installation drawings. Good understanding of hull outfitting components, attachment details, supports, installation clearances, fabrication methods, and shipyard construction requirements. Ability to interpret engineering drawings, vendor documentation, shop drawings, technical specifications, and production mark-ups. Experience resolving technical queries and supporting shipyard production teams during fabrication and installation activities. Familiarity with marine classification society rules, applicable shipbuilding standards, safety requirements, and project specifications. Experience coordinating with Hull Structure, Naval Architecture, Machinery Outfitting, Piping, HVAC, Electrical, and other engineering disciplines. Preferred Qualifications Experience in new-build shipbuilding projects, offshore vessels, FPSOs, or similar marine engineering projects. Exposure to international shipyards, marine EPC contractors, or multidisciplinary engineering environments. Required Skills Strong technical problem-solving, drawing interpretation, coordination, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a project-driven engineering and shipyard production environment.

f61d0aaa836d2710.description: Job Description Overview The Senior HSSEQ (Health, Safety, Security, Environment & Quality) Expert is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining HSSEQ management systems to ensure compliance with organizational, client, and regulatory requirements. The role provides strategic leadership in promoting a strong safety culture, managing risks, and driving continuous improvement initiatives across projects and operations. The Senior HSSEQ Expert works closely with leadership teams to enhance operational excellence, employee wellbeing, environmental sustainability, and quality performance. Your role Develop, implement, and monitor HSSEQ policies, procedures, and management systems. Ensure compliance with local regulations, international standards, and client HSSEQ requirements. Lead risk assessments, hazard identification programs, and mitigation strategies. Conduct HSSEQ audits, inspections, and performance reviews across operations and projects. Investigate incidents, accidents, and near misses, ensuring root cause analysis and corrective actions are implemented. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance safety, environmental, and quality performance. Provide HSSEQ guidance and support to project teams, contractors, and stakeholders. Develop and deliver HSSEQ training, awareness programs, and competency initiatives. Prepare and present HSSEQ reports, KPI dashboards, and regulatory submissions to senior management. Promote a proactive safety culture and champion behavioral safety programs. Monitor contractor performance and ensure compliance with HSSEQ standards. Support emergency preparedness, crisis management, and business continuity planning. Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor's degree in Engineering and Chartered, Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, or a related discipline. Professional certifications such as NEBOSH, IOSH, Lead Auditor (ISO 45001/14001/9001), or equivalent. 20+ years of HSSEQ experience, preferably within construction sectors. Strong knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 management systems. Experience in conducting audits, risk assessments, and incident investigations. Excellent understanding of regulatory compliance and industry best practices. Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills. Ability to influence organizational safety culture and drive performance improvements. Proficiency in HSSEQ reporting tools, data analysis, and performance monitoring. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making capabilities.

From managing supply chains for government mega-projects to coordinating logistics for private sector developments, your contributions will directly impact the success of BEC Arabia s ambitious initiatives. You will work closely with project managers, procurement teams, and external stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of resources while maintaining cost efficiency. With BEC Arabia s involvement in iconic projects such as NEOM, Diriyah Gate, and Red Sea Global, this position offers unparalleled opportunities for professional growth and exposure to transformative developments aligned with Saudi Vision 2030. Develop and implement logistics strategies to ensure timely delivery of materials, equipment, and resources. Coordinate with procurement, project management, and site teams to align logistics plans with project timelines. Monitor and manage vendor performance, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and quality standards. Ensure adherence to Saudi regulatory requirements, including customs clearance, transportation laws, and safety standards. Oversee inventory management processes, including tracking, storage, and distribution of materials. Negotiate contracts with logistics service providers to achieve cost-effective solutions without compromising quality. Implement and maintain logistics KPIs to measure performance and identify areas for improvement. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address logistics challenges and develop contingency plans. Environment: Combination of office and construction site settings; PPE usage required during site visits. Climate: Exposure to high temperatures during site visits; appropriate accommodations provided. Schedule: Full-time, with flexibility to address urgent logistics needs outside standard working hours. f685f711eaa9bda6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نسما للحراسات الأمنية عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ ومراقبة الإجراءات المتعلقة بدوام الموظفين وإجازاتهم، بالإضافة إلى التعامل مع استفساراتهم وشكواهم بمهنية عالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم المتنوعة، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، بما في ذلك تسجيل وتوثيق الترقيات والدورات التدريبية والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم جيد لأنظمة وإجراءات الموارد البشرية، خاصة فيما يتعلق بالدوام والإجازات. المهارات المطلوبة القدرة على تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في التعامل مع الموظفين وحل المشكلات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي عمليات الموارد البشرية ضمن فريق في شركة نسما للحراسات الأمنية، في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في بيئة عمل منظمة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور.

This position is responsible for ensuring high levels of service for residential owners. Working closely with the Director of Residences, the role requires strong leadership, communication skills, and a background in luxury hospitality or branded residential environments, ideally with HOA experience. Key Responsibilities Serve as the primary point of contact between residents and hotel departments, including Rooms, Engineering, Housekeeping, and Security. Ensure consistent delivery of personalized service and recognition for residents by maintaining accurate resident profiles. Attend and prepare for HOA and committee meetings to support governance and community involvement. Interact directly with residents to manage feedback, resolve issues, and update Golden HOME with accurate information. Manage and distribute accurate monthly house account statements to residents. Oversee the complete HOA billing process, including issuing statements, tracking payments, and following up on delinquencies. Collaborate with the Finance team to ensure timely vendor payments and invoice verification. Prepare and distribute monthly Opera-based resident spend reports and utility aging reports. Assist with the planning and execution of projects requiring unit access or impacting shared facilities. Conduct regular inspections of common areas and coordinate with Engineering and Landscaping for corrective action. Communicate progress of in-unit work and coordinate timelines with relevant departments and residents. Excellent communication abilities. Background in luxury hospitality or branded residential environments. Experience with Homeowners Association (HOA) administration is preferred. f6634b8bc462f59a.description: About RUA RUA is a forward-thinking institution for cross-cultural arts education and creative innovation in the Middle East that fosters bold ideas that inspire progress and transform society by cultivating industry and academic collaboration and rethinking creative education, all while creating a space for global ideas to flourish in a culturally inspiring environment. Our Vision To be an inspiring beacon of knowledge for future generations, integrating culture and arts, empowering students to discover passions and develop talents while fostering creativity and cultural exchange. Our Mission To cultivate an innovative educational environment in culture and arts, delivering cutting-edge programs that foster cultural and artistic engagement, enriching both the Saudi and global communities. Our Aspirations The leading cultural university across the Middle East and North Africa. Ranked among top 50 universities worldwide specializing in cultural education. A global hub for cultural education and knowledge exchange. About the Role The Faculty Affairs department, within the Provost Division at RUA, is seeking an experienced higher education professional to join as Senior Manager, Faculty Outreach. The postholder will lead faculty outreach and recruitment, translating academic staffing needs into targeted hiring actions and coordinating end-to-end sourcing, evaluation, and appointment processes to secure high-quality academic talent for the University. The role also maintains faculty talent pipelines, monitors recruitment market intelligence, and supports accurate faculty data management to inform workforce planning and accreditation needs. As RUA is a start-up institution, the postholder will help establish the policies, procedures, and sourcing strategies that underpin the University's academic hiring for years to come. The postholder reports to the Dean, Faculty Affairs and leads the Faculty Outreach team, working closely with College leadership, Human Resources, and Faculty Development and Engagement. Faculty Outreach and Recruitment Responsibilities: ●Own academic staffing intake by consolidating College requests, translating demand into role profiles and recruitment mandates, and confirming that requisitions align with HR processes and approved budgets ●Validate and coordinate faculty recruitment and appointment frameworks and policies with HR, including hiring criteria, rank and status, workload norms, credentialing standards, and faculty handbook provisions ●Build and execute faculty sourcing strategies through academic networks, institutional partnerships, targeted outreach campaigns, and discipline-specific channels ●Maintain faculty talent pipelines and recruitment market intelligence to support future hiring needs and workforce planning ●Lead the academic evaluation process by coordinating subject-matter assessment, engaging selection panels, ensuring consistent evidence capture, and producing recommendations for appointment decisions ●Coordinate negotiation of academic appointment terms, including rank, level, salary band, and academic conditions, with the Dean of Faculty Affairs, the Provost, and College leadership in coordination with HR ●Perform regular data quality checks, apply access controls, and produce standardised reports on recruitment outcomes, cycle efficiency, and sourcing effectiveness to support planning, compliance, and accreditation ●Build and sustain relationships with partner universities, academic networks, and external recruitment partners and search firms Leadership and Management Responsibilities ●Contribute to the Faculty Affairs business plan and develop the operational plan for Faculty Outreach in line with it ●Participate in departmental budgeting, ensure effective use of the section's budget, and report accurately on progress and challenges ●Lead the implementation of Faculty Outreach policies and procedures, monitor day-to-day compliance, and review them periodically against RUA's requirements and evolving market trends ●Guide, mentor, and appraise members of the Faculty Outreach team, setting performance objectives and providing regular feedback ●Establish a high-performance working environment and promote RUA's values ● Lead and manage outreach and recruitment projects, ensuring delivery within agreed cost, budget, timelines, scope, and quality standards. Ideal Experience and Skills ● Bachelor's degree in higher education administration, human resources, business administration, public administration, education leadership, or a related field; a Master's degree in one of these fields is preferred ● 7+ years of experience in higher education administration, faculty recruitment, academic HR, or talent acquisition, including at least 2 years in a managerial position ● Strong experience managing end-to-end recruitment workflows, candidate evaluation, appointment coordination, and workforce reporting in a complex academic environment ● Demonstrated ability to partner with senior leaders, HR, and academic stakeholders while balancing service quality, compliance, and data accuracy ● Sound understanding of academic ranks, credentialing standards, and faculty appointment frameworks ● Strong data analysis and reporting skills ● Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and organisational skills ● International academic and/or professional experience preferred To Apply ● A cover letter addressing your suitability for the role ● A detailed curriculum vitae, including: full employment history, dates and positions held; experience in faculty or academic recruitment, talent sourcing, and appointment coordination; management and team leadership experience; experience with recruitment data, reporting, and policy development; relevant professional certifications, memberships, and international experience ● A brief statement (max. 2 pages) outlining your approach to faculty sourcing and outreach for a start-up university Applications should be submitted to: [Click to show email] . Applicants are requested to include the position title in the subject line of the application email Why joining RUA: RUA represents a platform for discovery, a space where talent is nurtured, and a gateway for Saudi art and culture to the world. We welcome you to join us on this exceptional journey. Together, we will shape the ambitious cultural future of the Kingdom and inspire the world. As the first of its kind in the MENA region, RUA serves as a center of creativity, knowledge, and innovation, contributing to shaping the future of Saudi Arabia’s cultural ecosystem and creative economy, driving the growth of Saudi Arabia’s cultural sector in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030.

f699c0506384e46c.job_title: Director - Public Health and Community Engagement (DEL2)
f699c0506384e46c.description: The Director of Public Health and Community Engagement is responsible for establishing and leading the public health function across Qiddiya City. The role will develop Qiddiya’s five-year public health strategy and establish the policies, standards, and systems required to protect the health of residents, employees, contractors, and visitors. The position holds accountability for disease surveillance, outbreak management, occupational health standards, disease prevention, and community health engagement. The role also represents Medical Operations on public health matters and works closely with government authorities, healthcare providers, and internal stakeholders. Job responsibilities: Public Health Strategy and Policy Develop and maintain Qiddiya’s five-year public health plan. Establish the public health policy framework, standards, thresholds, and intervention triggers. Translate national health priorities and Ministry of Health requirements into practical policies for Qiddiya City. Develop population health profiles, risk assessments, and public health data models. Advise the Executive Director on long-term strategy, resources, partnerships, and public health priorities. Disease Surveillance and Outbreak Management Design and oversee disease surveillance systems across Qiddiya assets and contracted healthcare provider locations. Ensure compliance with notifiable disease reporting requirements. Lead outbreak investigations and chair the outbreak control team. Oversee contact tracing, disease prevention, and vaccination requirements. Provide recommendations regarding the closure of venues or assets during public health incidents. Maintain effective reporting and escalation relationships with relevant health authorities. Define the environmental health information required from internal and external partners. Occupational Health Establish occupational health standards for Qiddiya employees, contractors, and service providers. Define health surveillance requirements for roles with specific exposure or physical demands. Clarify responsibilities across occupational health, public health, and clinical service delivery. Include occupational health requirements within contracted healthcare services. Monitor and verify that contracted providers deliver services according to agreed standards. Community Health Engagement Provide strategic oversight of the Qiddiya Life Saver Program and wider lay-responder initiatives. Establish program direction, targets, performance measures, and governance requirements. Develop the Public Access Defibrillator network plan, including coverage, placement, governance, and expansion. Define the community health engagement approach for residents, employees, and visitors. Establish measurement frameworks to assess the effectiveness and value of community health programs. Leadership and Governance Lead, manage, and develop the public health team. Represent Medical Operations on public health matters internally and externally. Prepare and present reports, business cases, and recommendations to senior management. Manage budgets, resources, contracts, and departmental priorities. Maintain strong relationships with government authorities, healthcare providers, and internal stakeholders. Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and delegated authorities. Identify, assess, manage, and escalate public health risks. Drive continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence. Requirements: Education Master of Public Health, or an equivalent postgraduate qualification in public health, is mandatory. Professional Certifications Occupational health qualification or recognized equivalent is preferred. Field epidemiology training or an equivalent applied epidemiology certification is preferred. Experience Minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience in public health practice. Proven experience developing a public health plan, policy framework, or program from the beginning. Practical experience in disease surveillance and outbreak investigation. Experience leading or making a significant contribution to an outbreak response. Experience working across multiple organizations or functions where responsibilities and authority are shared. Experience establishing a new public health function is preferred. Experience in mass-gathering, events, entertainment destinations, or visitor-focused public health is preferred. Experience in occupational health is preferred. Familiarity with Saudi Ministry of Health regulations and notifiable disease requirements is preferred. General healthcare, hospital, or clinical management experience alone does not replace the required public health experience. Skills and Competencies Strong strategic and population-level analytical thinking. Ability to make informed decisions when information is incomplete. Strong policy, planning, and professional writing skills. Ability to prepare documents suitable for executive and regulatory review. Strong negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder-management skills. Good knowledge of surveillance systems, data models, and public health reporting. Leadership and team-development capability. Working proficiency in both Arabic and English.

f6f65455bd8ef3b3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور على تركيب وصيانة ومراقبة المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين الكهربائيين. يتطلب الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد المخطط، وتقدير كمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين فيما يتعلق بأعمال تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية. اختبار الأنظمة بعد تركيبها لضمان التقيد بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن أعمال الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ لتقليل فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. تقديم المساعدة والدعم للمهندسين الكهربائيين في حل المشكلات الفنية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لمبادئ تركيب وصيانة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الكهربائية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتقديم الدعم الفني. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في جميع المهام. مهارات تنظيمية وتنسيقية جيدة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو دوام كامل ويقع في تبوك. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في مشاريع المقاولات الكهربائية. تقديم الطلبات نحن ندعو المرشحين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين الذين تتوافق مؤهلاتهم مع متطلبات الوظيفة.

f638909a94ae44f6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة بشكل كامل، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتعلقة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. فهم قوي لمبادئ عمل نظم التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية والرسومات الهندسية. متطلبات العمل الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات الفنية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف ضمن فريق شركة سراكو في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الحضور في الموقع لإنجاز مهام التركيب والصيانة والإصلاح. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة سراكو، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

f63d509d9b48a85d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مصنع مدينة الخرسانه عن مدير عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف المباشر على أنشطة إدارة وتخطيط وتنظيم عمليات الموارد البشرية، وضمان كفاءة وفعالية سير العمليات اليومية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في وضع الأهداف الرئيسية وخطط وبرامج عمليات الموارد البشرية. الإشراف على أنشطة إدارة وتخطيط وتنظيم عمليات الموارد البشرية. متابعة فرق العمل لضمان توافر كافة الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات. المشاركة في تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية لإدارة عمليات الموارد البشرية، والتأكد من وجود الأطر والمقاييس الدقيقة لتحقيق هذه الخطط والأهداف. تطوير الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التفصيلية لعمليات وإجراءات الموارد البشرية، وإدارة رسم العمليات وتخطيطها وتحسينها المستمر. متابعة تنفيذ العمليات والإجراءات لضمان أفضل المخرجات وتحقيق أعلى مستويات الخدمات والكفاءات. متابعة التعديلات والتغييرات في سياسات الموارد البشرية والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية لتعكس هذه التعديلات على عمليات الموارد البشرية (مثل الإجازات، النقل، التدريب، الترقية). تحديد احتياجات إدارة عمليات الموارد البشرية من الموارد المالية والبشرية والمستلزمات الإدارية. الإشراف على إعداد وتحضير الملخصات والتقارير العامة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا. إحاطة الإدارة العليا بالتحديات والمستجدات واستشارتهم في القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية المهمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم قوي لمبادئ وإجراءات الموارد البشرية. القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية ممتازة. القدرة على التخطيط والتنظيم الفعال. مهارات تحليلية قوية لإعداد التقارير. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتنسيق مع الإدارات المختلفة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في مصنع مدينة الخرسانه. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

f6844f5ce8782b07.description: The Cloud Architect is responsible for defining, designing, and governing secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-effective cloud and hybrid-cloud architectures. The role supports cloud strategy, cloud adoption, landing zones, migration, modernization, governance, security, platform services, and integration with existing enterprise environments. The Cloud Architect ensures cloud solutions are aligned with enterprise architecture principles, business priorities, security requirements, regulatory obligations, and operational standards. · Develop and maintain the enterprise cloud architecture in alignment with business strategy, enterprise architecture, and technology direction. · Define cloud strategy, cloud adoption approaches, and target-state cloud architecture. · Design secure and scalable cloud landing zones for enterprise workloads. · Define architecture for public cloud, private cloud, hybrid cloud, and multi-cloud environments. · Develop cloud reference architectures, architecture principles, patterns, guardrails, and technical standards. · Assess application and infrastructure workloads for cloud suitability, migration approach, and modernization opportunities. · Define cloud migration strategies including rehost, replatform, refactor, replace, retire, and retain approaches where applicable. · Design cloud networking, connectivity, identity, access management, security, logging, monitoring, and operational architecture. · Define architecture for cloud-native services, containers, Kubernetes, serverless platforms, managed services, and platform services. · Support application modernization and cloud-native transformation initiatives. · Define requirements for resilience, availability, backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and performance in cloud environments. · Embed cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory, and compliance requirements into cloud architecture designs. · Support cloud governance, subscription/account structures, resource organization, policy enforcement, and tagging standards. · Promote cost optimization and FinOps principles within cloud architecture decisions. · Collaborate with application, integration, data, security, infrastructure, DevOps, and solution architects. · Conduct architecture reviews and assess cloud solutions for compliance with enterprise standards. · Support cloud platform selection, technology evaluation, vendor assessment, and proof-of-concept activities. · Identify cloud architecture risks, dependencies, constraints, and mitigation actions. Required Experience · Minimum 8-10 years of experience in infrastructure, cloud engineering, systems engineering, solution architecture, or related technology disciplines. · At least 4-5 years of hands-on experience in Cloud Architecture or a comparable senior cloud design role. · Demonstrated experience designing enterprise-scale cloud and hybrid-cloud environments. · Experience with cloud migration, modernization, landing zones, governance, security, networking, and identity architecture. · Experience supporting large-scale cloud transformation or digital transformation programs. · Strong experience working with technology teams, cybersecurity teams, vendors, and senior stakeholders. Core Competencies · Enterprise Cloud Architecture · Cloud strategy and adoption planning · Cloud landing zone architecture · Hybrid and multi-cloud architecture · Cloud migration and modernization · Cloud-native architecture · Cloud networking and connectivity · Cloud identity and access architecture · Cloud security and compliance · Container and Kubernetes architecture · Resilience, backup, and disaster recovery · Cloud governance and policy management · FinOps and cloud cost optimization · Architecture governance and assurance Preferred Frameworks, Standards & Methods · TOGAF · ArchiMate · AWS Well-Architected Framework · Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework · Google Cloud Architecture Framework · Cloud Adoption Frameworks · Zero Trust architecture principles · DevOps and DevSecOps practices · Infrastructure-as-Code principles · Cloud security and governance best practices Preferred Tools & Technology Exposure · Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or equivalent cloud platforms. · Cloud networking, identity, security, monitoring, logging, backup, and governance services. · Container and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes. · Infrastructure-as-Code technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, or equivalent. · CI/CD and DevOps platforms such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, or equivalent. · Enterprise architecture tools such as Bizzdesign, Sparx Enterprise Architect, Orbus/iServer, ARIS, or similar platforms. Preferred Qualifications & Certifications · Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline. · Professional-level cloud architecture certification from Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, or equivalent is highly desirable. · TOGAF certification is desirable. · Relevant cloud security, Kubernetes, DevOps, or infrastructure certifications are advantageous. Personal Attributes · Strong analytical and systems-thinking capability. · Ability to translate business and technology requirements into pragmatic cloud architecture decisions. · Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. · Ability to work across enterprise architecture, security, infrastructure, application, data, and DevOps teams. · Strong focus on architecture quality, security, scalability, resilience, and cost effectiveness. · Consulting mindset with the ability to support complex transformation programs and multiple stakeholders.

f6f264d2a8fab4d1.description: About Us Tamara is a leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region with a mission to help people own their dreams built on being simple, trusted, and everywhere our customers need us. Today, more than 25 million customers and over 130,000 partner merchants depend on Tamara every day for reliable financial solutions across retail, travel, education, healthcare, and beyond. Your Role The Head of AML will lead and manage the overall operations, activities, and responsibilities of the AML/CTF Department, reporting administratively to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and functionally to the Audit Committee. The role is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining the company’s Anti-Money Laundering, Counter-Terrorist Financing, and Proliferation Financing (AML/CTF/PF) framework in Saudi Arabia. This includes ensuring compliance with the Saudi Anti-Money Laundering Law and its Implementing Regulations, SAMA requirements, SAFIU reporting obligations, and applicable Targeted Financial Sanctions requirements. The Head of AML will work closely with business and control functions to identify and assess financial-crime risks, ensure that effective controls are implemented consistently across the company, remediate identified gaps, and promote a strong culture of AML/CTF/PF compliance. Your Responsibilities AML/CTF/PF Framework and Controls: Develop, implement, monitor, and continuously enhance the company’s AML/CTF/PF framework and controls to ensure their effectiveness and alignment with applicable regulatory requirements. Oversight of AML/CTF/PF Operations: Lead and oversee the AML/CTF Unit’s activities, ensuring that all responsibilities are performed effectively and that identified control or process deficiencies are addressed promptly. Policies and Procedures: Develop, maintain, and periodically review the company’s AML/CTF/PF policies, procedures, standards, and operating controls to reflect regulatory developments, emerging risks, and relevant industry practices. Enterprise-Wide Risk Assessment: Oversee the identification and assessment of money laundering, terrorist financing, and proliferation financing risks arising from the company’s customers, products, services, transactions, delivery channels, and geographic exposure. Stakeholder Management and Advisory: Build and maintain effective relationships with key internal stakeholders and provide guidance and advice on AML/CTF/PF risks, regulatory requirements, new products, business initiatives, and control enhancements.
